name: Avatars

examples.title: Default
examples.code:
<Avatars>
  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />
  <Avatar name="Grace Hopper" />
  <Avatar name="Katherine Johnson" />
</Avatars>

examples.title: Clamped with a Surplus Bubble
examples.code:
<Avatars max={3} size="48x48">
  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />
  <Avatar name="Grace Hopper" />
  <Avatar name="Katherine Johnson" />
  <Avatar name="Margaret Hamilton" />
  <Avatar name="Radia Perlman" />
</Avatars>

examples.title: Localized Surplus Label
examples.code:
<Avatars max={3} surplusLabel={count => `${count} weitere`}>
  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />
  <Avatar name="Grace Hopper" />
  <Avatar name="Katherine Johnson" />
  <Avatar name="Margaret Hamilton" />
  <Avatar name="Radia Perlman" />
</Avatars>

accessibility:
- `Avatars` is a plain container — each child `Avatar` carries its own accessible name (see
  [Avatar's accessibility notes](./avatar.md#accessibility)).
- The `+N` surplus avatar gets an accessible name of `"{N} more"` (via its `alt`), so assistive
  tech announces how many members are hidden. Localize it with `surplusLabel`, e.g.
  ``surplusLabel={count => `${count} weitere`}``.
- A focused clickable avatar is lifted above its overlapping neighbours so its focus outline
  is never partially covered.
- When the group represents a labelled set (e.g. "Project members"), give the container a
  `role="group"` and an `aria-label` describing it.
summary: The `Avatars` component renders an overlapping/stacked group of `Avatar`s, the "members" list pattern.

parts.summary: The `Avatars` component renders an overlapping/stacked group of `Avatar`s, the "members" list pattern.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: max
props.description: Show only the first `max` children, replacing the overflow with a "+N" surplus avatar. A single overflow avatar is shown directly rather than as a pointless "+1".

props.name: size
props.description: Uniform size applied to every child `Avatar` (and the surplus avatar).

props.name: shape
props.description: Uniform shape applied to every child `Avatar` (and the surplus avatar); a child's own `shape` wins when this is unset.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Space between avatars: a preset or a pixel `number`. The overlap distance, or the gap when `spaced`.

props.name: spaced
props.description: Lay the avatars out side by side (non-overlapping), using `spacing` as the gap.

props.name: surplusLabel
props.description: Builds the surplus avatar's accessible name from the hidden count, for localization. Default: `` `${count} more` ``.

props.name: children
props.description: `Avatar` elements to render inside the group.

parts.catchAll: All standard <div> attributes and Bulma helper props

parts.summary: The `Avatar` component represents a person or entity as a compact image.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. On load error (or if absent), falls back to initials, then `icon`.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternate text for the image (used for the accessible name in every render mode). An explicit `alt=""` marks a non-interactive avatar as decorative.

props.name: name
props.description: Derives initials and a deterministic background color when no `src` is shown.

props.name: initials
props.description: Explicit initials override (else derived from `name`).

props.name: icon
props.description: Final fallback, rendered when there is no `src`, `name`, or `initials`.

props.name: size
props.description: Preset size, or a pixel size when a number.

props.name: shape
props.description: Avatar shape. Default `'circle'`.

props.name: color
props.description: Background color for initials/icon avatars (else auto-derived from `name`).

props.name: as
props.description: Element/component to render as. Defaults to `'a'` when `href` is set, else `'figure'`.

props.name: href
props.description: When set, renders the avatar as a link.

props.name: target
props.description: Anchor target — forwarded only when rendering a link (an `a` or a custom `as` component).

props.name: rel
props.description: Anchor rel — forwarded only when rendering a link (an `a` or a custom `as` component).

props.name: imageProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the underlying `` (e.g. `loading`, `crossOrigin`); its `onError` is chained before the fallback fires.
